set.body:
Source: review findings in FailureDiagnosis.scala and WireEnvelope encoding plus productPrefix persistence.

Problem:
diagnostic tie-breaking uses cause.toString, productPrefix leaks source names into persisted data, and reserved-key extensions can be silently dropped so encode/decode does not round-trip.

Acceptance:
- Give persisted/event/diagnostic variants explicit stable codes and explicit deterministic priority keys.
- Never derive wire identity or ordering from toString, productPrefix, class names, or source declaration order.
- Make reserved extension collisions impossible at construction or return a typed encoding error; never silently discard caller data.
- Add compatibility fixtures and property tests covering round-trip, stable ordering, reserved keys, and unknown extensions.
set.title: P6f.13: Remove unstable names and lossy extension behavior from persistence
